name: Pale Indian-plantain
desc: Pale Indian-plantain (Arnoglossum atriplicifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Arnoglossum atriplicifolium, the pale Indian plantain, is a perennial herbaceous wildflower in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). native to the central and eastern United States.
